## Methods

<a id="member-744749cbb0632fc5"></a>

### Read(string, string?)

Reads embedded installation metadata without loading or executing the native library or reading sidecar files.

```csharp
public static ExtensionSchema Read(string libraryPath, string? runtimeIdentifier = null)
```

Parameters:

`libraryPath` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The published shared-library file.

`runtimeIdentifier` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

An optional required RID; universal Mach-O files require osx-x64 or osx-arm64.

Returns: [ExtensionSchema](/api/ankus.pgconfig.extensionschema/)

The validated schema and publication identity.

Exceptions:

- [FormatException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.formatexception): The library, embedded format, target identity or bounded metadata is invalid.

Supports Linux x64 ELF, Windows x64 PE and macOS x64/ARM64 Mach-O libraries.
Schema sections are limited to 64 MiB; native library contents are read through bounded file ranges.
